purpose: Teach: 縮減/教示/貸し付け/取り付ける/通帳/差し止め/持ち株/引き下げる

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: 社内研修で経費縮減のヒントを共有しましょう
lines.en: Let's share some cost-reduction ideas from today's training session.
lines.style: Clear, professional opener. Measured pace, inviting but businesslike. Slight lean-in on 'share'—collaborative, not directive.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。新人にも基本操作をご教示します
lines.en: Understood. I'll make sure the new staff get the fundamentals down.
lines.style: Warm acknowledgment. Straightforward, capable tone. Quick nod in the voice. Ready to move forward—no hesitation.

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: お取引先への貸し付け状況を確認しましょう
lines.en: Let's check in on our partner company's loan status.
lines.style: Even, attentive delivery. Steady eye-contact level in the voice. Methodical—moving down a list but genuinely present.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。受付に防犯ブザーを取り付ける手配中です
lines.en: Will do. I'm arranging the security alarm installation at the front desk.
lines.style: Brief, factual update. Efficient but not rushed. Confidence that the task is in progress—no defensiveness.

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: 社員の通帳記帳代行は禁止しましょう
lines.en: We should make it clear—no one should process bankbook transactions on behalf of staff.
lines.style: Quiet firmness. Slight emphasis on the boundary being set, but not harsh. Protective, not punitive.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。コピー商品の差し止め申請を検討中です
lines.en: Understood. We're looking into filing for counterfeit product seizure.
lines.style: Steady, solution-focused. Quick intake breath before 'counterfeit'—showing active attention. No filler.

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: 役員の持ち株割合を確認しましょう
lines.en: Let's verify the shareholding percentages for the executive board.
lines.style: Measured, procedural. Slight formality here—this matters. Calm authority without stiffness.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。手数料を引き下げる方針です
lines.en: Got it. We're moving forward with a fee reduction strategy.
lines.style: Decisive close. Light emphasis on 'forward'—wrapping up clearly. Affirming the direction without fanfare.
